inherits.inheritance_rule: All economy-v2 fields are inherited unchanged unless this explicit overlay names a Huaguoshan future-route XP delta or a non-executable future-route semantic binding.

scope.included: Only the future Huaguoshan Lv1-Lv20 design-route XP repair that removes an optional Peng Demon King clear from the mandatory progression total, plus the non-executable future-route semantics that bind XP_PEACH and XP_CAVE to mandatory public mainline nodes.
excluded: currency, material, drop, pity, qualification, receipt, tower, equipment, artifact, source-profile, and runtime changes
any recalculation, migration, or rewrite of a historical receipt
scope.historical_receipt_rule: A receipt created under economy-v2 remains bound to economy-v2. This overlay may only be selected by a later separately reviewed authoritative integration for a new future event.

row_overrides.reason: Moves the 590 XP removed from the final chapter-clear row into the mandatory East Sea route so either fork reaches the same pre-clear anchor.
Keeps the Lv20 total unchanged after the East Sea route repair.

new_design_route_rows.design_route_role: non-combat discovery branch that replaces the Peng Demon King XP when the player declines that optional boss

anti_double_claim.rule: One future route chooses exactly one branch. A design, adapter, or receipt plan that credits both branch keys for the same Huaguoshan route is invalid.

route_choice.no_boss_path_rule: XP_HG_CRACK_DISCOVERY must remain available without defeating Peng Demon King; XP_PENG must never become a chapter-entry or chapter-clear prerequisite.

route_math.formula: before_choice_xp + exactly_one_choice_xp + after_choice_before_clear_xp = pre_clear_xp; pre_clear_xp + chapter_clear_xp = final_xp

non_production_boundary.implementation_rule: This overlay is not a Y3 table, a live ledger instruction, a materializer input, or a source-profile allocation. A future integration must separately bind the immutable version/hash, route choice, authority evidence, and receipt semantics before any award can occur.

must_verify: economy-v2 file hash and inheritance version
only XP_EASTSEA and XP_CHAPTER_CLEAR are overridden
the new crack discovery row is the only new route row
XP_PEACH and XP_CAVE retain historical source kinds while gaining only explicit future mandatory-public-mainline semantics
Peng-or-crack has exactly-one selection and an explicit anti-double-claim rule
the two branch totals, Lv19 anchor, Lv20 anchor, and 55-minute anchor remain exact
runtime and economic execution remain disabled
